Why choose AUT?

We're not your typical university, and that's the point. We've built something different here – a place where you belong exactly as you are and where your learning connects directly to real-world impact. Our students learn through real workplace experience, get the support they need to tackle genuine challenges and graduate with knowledge that actually works when it counts.

We do things differently because different gets better results. Ready to see what that means?

DISCOVER MORE

AUT isn't afraid to challenge the conventional methods of education. What makes AUT special is that it doesn't just give you answers – it encourages you to ask questions, think critically and bring your own identity into your work.

AUT is more than just a university; it’s a village, a community that embraces you with open arms. Here you don’t just study – you belong. You’ll find a community that not only cares about your academic success but also your personal wellbeing.

AUT has always been a place where students can walk in feeling welcomed and become part of a culture that strives for success. AUT has a great track record of preparing students for their future, and the opportunities given to students are evident in the success of past students.

AUT taught me how to network really well and this skill has been crucial for building relationships with other health professionals. Podiatry is usually a small cohort of students, so my classmates and I were always close. The lecturers were also easy to approach.

AUT’s reputation for being practical is being valued by Kiwi employers. I can still remember the lecturers using real-world examples to illustrate why materials behave differently under tension and can memorise writing the PID control loops to fly a drone.

A smart investment in your future

Your education is one of the biggest decisions you'll make. At AUT, we've built something that delivers real value – not just a degree, but the skills, connections and confidence that employers are looking for. Our graduates don't just find jobs, they're ready to hit the ground running from day one. With industry partnerships that matter, you're investing in a university that invests back in your success.

Research that matters

Problems that keep communities up at night? We're working on those. Our research tackles real-world challenges – from AI and robotics to ecology and public health – creating knowledge that works well beyond the university. We partner with industry and communities to ensure discoveries translate into meaningful change. This applied approach has earned us five-star research recognition from QS and reflects our commitment to research with purpose.

DISCOVER MORE

Health monitoring, reimagined

AUT's Institute of Biomedical Technologies develops affordable wearable biosensing technology that measures and manages human physiology at scale.

Nature-based solutions that work

AUT's Living Laboratories run real-world restoration experiments across urban and rural environments, monitored through remote sensing.

Tools that protect the brain

AUT's Brain Health Research Institute develops practical clinical tools now used throughout New Zealand to identify traumatic brain injury risk.

When disaster strikes, be ready

AUT researchers use geospatial mapping and drone surveys to help communities prepare for earthquakes, flooding and climate change.

AI that works when it counts

AUT researchers are developing MRI and retinal imaging AI that performs reliably in real clinical settings, not just labs.

Research that changes the game

Peak performance and long-term wellbeing are not competing goals – AUT's SPRINZ connects research directly to sport organisations worldwide.
